# config.sh: key=value config access
CFG_FILE=${CFG_FILE:-etc/app.conf}

# get_cfg KEY: print the value of KEY (exit 1 + message if missing)
get_cfg() {
  local line
  line=$(grep -m1 "^$1=" "$CFG_FILE") || { echo "get_cfg: missing key $1" >&2; return 1; }
  echo "${line#*=}"
}

# get_cfg_path KEY: like get_cfg, but resolves a relative value against the
# directory of the config file
get_cfg_path() {
  local v
  v=$(get_cfg "$1") || return 1
  case $v in
    /*) echo "$v" ;;
    *) echo "$(dirname "$CFG_FILE")/$v" ;;
  esac
}

# get_cfg_or KEY DEFAULT
get_cfg_or() { get_cfg "$1" 2>/dev/null || echo "$2"; }

# forget_cfg: drop the configured file name
forget_cfg() { unset CFG_FILE; }
. lib/config.sh
db_dsn() {
  local path
  path=$(get_cfg_path db_file) || return 1
  echo "sqlite://$path?user=$(get_cfg_or db_user app)"
}
db_check() {
  if ! get_cfg db_file >/dev/null; then
    echo 'db: get_cfg failed for db_file' >&2
    return 1
  fi
}
. lib/config.sh
net_port() { get_cfg port; }
net_url() { echo "http://$(get_cfg host):$(get_cfg port)/"; }
#!/bin/bash
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
. lib/net.sh
. lib/db.sh
declare -A handlers=([get]=get_cfg [path]=get_cfg_path [url]=net_url [dsn]=db_dsn [check]=db_check)
usage() { echo "usage: app get|path|url|dsn|check [KEY]  (get uses get_cfg)" >&2; exit 2; }
[ $# -gt 0 ] || usage
h=${handlers[$1]:-}
[ -n "$h" ] || usage
shift
"$h" "$@"
#!/bin/bash
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
. lib/config.sh
for k in host port db_file; do
  printf '%-8s %s\n' "$k" "$(get_cfg_or "$k" '<unset>')"
done
command -v get_cfg >/dev/null && echo "doctor: get_cfg available"
#!/bin/bash
# The suite was updated for the get_cfg -> config_get rename.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
. tests/assert.sh
export CFG_FILE=tests/fixtures/app.conf
(
  . lib/config.sh
  if declare -F get_cfg >/dev/null; then echo "get_cfg must no longer be defined"; exit 1; fi
  assert_eq 8080 "$(config_get port)" 'config_get port'
  assert_eq 'tests/fixtures/data/app.db' "$(get_cfg_path db_file)" 'get_cfg_path'
  assert_eq fallback "$(get_cfg_or nope fallback)" 'get_cfg_or'
  assert_eq 'get_cfg: missing key nope' "$(config_get nope 2>&1)" 'missing-key message'
  forget_cfg
  [ -z "${CFG_FILE+x}" ] || { echo 'forget_cfg must unset CFG_FILE'; exit 1; }
) || exit 1
assert_eq 8080 "$(bash bin/app get port)" 'app get'
assert_eq 'tests/fixtures/data/app.db' "$(bash bin/app path db_file)" 'app path'
assert_eq 'http://localhost:8080/' "$(bash bin/app url)" 'app url'
assert_eq 'sqlite://tests/fixtures/data/app.db?user=app' "$(bash bin/app dsn)" 'app dsn'
assert_eq 'usage: app get|path|url|dsn|check [KEY]  (get uses get_cfg)' "$(bash bin/app 2>&1)" 'usage text'
assert_eq "$(printf 'get_cfg: missing key db_file\ndb: get_cfg failed for db_file')" "$(CFG_FILE=tests/fixtures/empty.conf bash bin/app check 2>&1)" 'db_check messages'
assert_eq "$(printf 'host     localhost\nport     8080\ndb_file  <unset>\ndoctor: get_cfg available')" "$(CFG_FILE=tests/fixtures/nodb.conf bash bin/doctor)" 'doctor'
echo "PASS" | tee build/test-report.txt
